s: In the list of 12 superbugs released by WHO recently, which of the following finds place in Critical Category?
src: APPSC Inspector of Factories, Civil Assistant Surgeons & Fis
x:
the WHO 2017 list of 12 superbugs was replaced by the WHO Bacterial Priority Pathogens List 2024 (15 families) — carbapenem-resistant A. baumannii is still critical (who.int, 17 May 2024)

s: Which of the following parasites is responsible for 65% of the cases of malaria in India ?
x:
P. vivax is no longer India's main malaria parasite — now P. falciparum causes ~60% of cases and P. vivax ~40% (NCVBDC data for 2024, orfonline.org)
P. vivax was long given as causing about 65% of India's malaria cases (relapsing malaria). (now P. falciparum causes ~60% of cases, 2024)

s: Which of the following is the key programme for prevention/control of outbreaks/epidemics of malaria, dengue, chikungunya etc., vaccines administered to reduce the morbidity and mortality due to diseases like measles, diphtheria, pertussis, poliomyelitis etc?
o: Inter-Sectoral coordination for Prevention and Control of Zoonotic Diseases
National Vector Borne Diseases Control Programme
src: APPSC Assistant Executive Engineer (AEE) General Studies & M
x:
NVBDCP is now the National Center for Vector Borne Diseases Control (NCVBDC) (ncvbdc.mohfw.gov.in)
The National Vector Borne Disease Control Programme (now NCVBDC) is the key programme for prevention and control of malaria, dengue, chikungunya and other vector-borne outbreaks. IDSP only does surveillance and the yaws programme ended in 2006. The vaccine part of the stem refers to UIP. (now NCVBDC)

s: The anaemia control programme in India provides Iron Folic Acid supplements (IFA) consisting of ____ daily for 100 days to pregnant women.
src: APPSC Group-III Mains Panchayat Secretary (Grade-IV) Paper-I
x:
100 mg iron for 100 days was the old norm — now Anaemia Mukt Bharat gives 60 mg elemental iron + 500 mcg folic acid daily for 180 days to pregnant women (AP Socio-Economic Survey 2024-25 p.218: 180 red IFA tablets; dose general knowledge).
Under the older National Anaemia Prophylaxis/Control Programme pregnant women got IFA tablets of 100 mg elemental iron + 500 mcg folic acid daily for 100 days (now 60 mg iron for 180 days under Anaemia Mukt Bharat).

s: According to the National Health Accounts (NHA) Estimates for 2019-20, what is the share of Out-of-Pocket Expenditure (OOPE) in total Health Expenditure in India?
